mbu -- Merrill Backup Utility

Efficiently create and update bootable backup disks
from your running Linux system. 
Switch instantly to your backup disk if your main system fails - 
losing only work since your last backup. 
Free and open source! 

Written entirely in bash.
Should work as is on any mainstream Linux desktop/laptop distribution,
with the possible exception of the (very minimal and optional) GUI.

Entirely written by Ted Merrill.
Released by Ted Merrill to the public domain 
or under the MIT or BSD licenses at your discretion... I don't care.
I just would like this to be of use to someone somewhere.

Please see mbu-README.txt for further information.
